verification_report.summary: The two supplied proofs are correct. The product-model proof validly globalizes local extended-real convexity, constructs a common compact metrizable Stone quotient for a decreasing sequence, descends upper semicontinuity, and builds fixed-domain decreasing smooth convex majorants by sup-regularization, fibre convexification, clopen discretization, smoothing, and a summable monotonicity correction. The generator-convex complex result then follows by valid transport, restriction, and chart-independence arguments; the two-ray obstruction and all stated edge cases are correctly handled. The explicit Chambert--Loir--Ducros specialization was checked against primary definitions and positivity results, and the model result (M) is exactly the theorem proved earlier in the same markdown. No critical error or logical gap was found.
